content_authority_order: ORIGINAL current Unit Assessment Plan in assessment_plans/ for exact Unit learning/evidence scope and intentional AP-topic grouping
current College Board AP Calculus AB/BC Course and Exam Description for official AP terminology, conditions, mathematical practices, calculator expectations, and exam framing
AP Topics scoring-guide corpus for authentic AP task/FRQ/scoring morphology
teacher AP Calculus 40-section course framework for course organization/classroom flow
calculus textbook for explanation depth/examples/applications/additional archetypes
Framework derivative indexes/curated packets as retrieval aids only
conflict_rules: Assessment Plan controls what this course/unit assesses and which AP topics are intentionally grouped in each section.
CED controls official AP definitions/terminology/conditions where a generic textbook differs.
AP Topics inform task/scoring style but never override the Assessment Plan or reveal secure/source answers by direct cloning.
Physics source is tone only; never import Physics content into Calculus.
universal_bank_rule: Current Bank PM owns Bank execution/data/package/security mechanics. Framework supplies AP Calculus-specific mathematical/representation/response requirements and exact Unit authority; AP source selected-response examples do not override the active course response contract.
philosophy_rule: Current Curriculum Philosophy PM supplies universal map-first/repetition/evidence beliefs. It does not override Assessment Plan mathematics or CED terminology/conditions.
map_first_repetition_rule: Apply contracts/map_first_repetition_contract.json before multi-item/multi-section authoring. Purposeful repetition may remain; revise only template-driven repetition lacking a mapped learning/evidence purpose.
system_authority_order: current explicit teacher instruction for the specific job
current Curriculum Philosophy PM for universal principles
current AP Calculus AB Framework for course-specific behavior; ORIGINAL Unit Assessment Plan is exact authority within the Framework for Unit learning/evidence
current executable task PM for procedure
question_structure_rule: Universal question/evidence structures are owned by current `_question_structure.zip`. Framework question/task archetype menus are Calculus-specific enrichment and cannot become a competing universal taxonomy.
task_pm_rule: Current task PM owns required-input resolution, validation, execution sequence, QA/package procedure, and output.
tool_rule: Graph/finalizer/MathJax/CSS mechanics are implementation dependencies owned by tools/CSS and invoked according to the current task PM/course-specific requirement.
